description: `multiverse result <task-id>` returns a finished task's result.md verbatim (gateway.py's read_result: redacted, never rewritten) for a task id carrying an OLD pre-rename dispatch role name (`designer`) — the role substring in the task id is never parsed or validated by this command at all (gateway.py / cli.py never call RoleId(...) on it), only the generic task-id identifier shape and the status file's terminal state matter. Pure file read: no routing.log entry is even required for this command to work, and no herdr call is made.
